widgets.text: Drop columns of three jewels; line up 3 or more of a colour horizontally, vertically or diagonally to clear them. Chains score more.
In Flash and versus modes, chains send garbage to the rival; magic jewels (the gem pieces) cast attacks or shields.
widgets.title: Tips

widgets.text: Collected magic gems are equipped before a match; each gives one spell (raise rival's field, clear rows, slow drops...).
Magic gems are won through story and versus wins; collect the full set to fill the gem list.
Story mode: beat each rival in turn to reach the Crown.
